name: Reclaiming Ravencrest
summary: Commander Truesong sends you to Ravencrest Monument in Azshara, where Spitelash naga channel their magic through power stones. Nullifying the stones and thinning their ranks may help drive them out.

sections.title: At the Monument
sections.body: The monument is all that remains to show the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest was here. You find it atop the cliffs at the southern peninsula’s tip. Spitelash enchantresses use power stones to channel their magic, and Commander Truesong gives you a ward to nullify them. Their magic is the obstacle to driving the naga out.

faq.answer: Ravencrest Monument is the lone, crumbling proof that the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest was present in Azshara.
Ravencrest Monument stands atop the cliffs at the tip of Azshara’s southern peninsula.

faq.q: Why does Truesong want the power stones nullified?
faq.answer: Spitelash enchantresses channel their magic through the stones. Nullifying them will cripple that magic and give an upper hand in driving out the Spitelash.

faq.q: Who are you sent to fight?
faq.answer: Commander Truesong asks you to kill Spitelash Battlemasters and Enchantresses, and to nullify Naga Power Stones near Ravencrest Monument.
